featured_discoveries.author: Joel Dietz

featured_discoveries.title: How Nature Builds 10,000 Fishes: Resolving D'Arcy Thompson's 1917 Transformation Paradox Across 10,303 Species
featured_discoveries.author: Joel Dietz
featured_discoveries.tldr_13yo: Global growth rules (D'Arcy Thompson's curved rubber sheet) shape the outside of a fish for swimming over 150 million years (94%–99% alignment across 440 families), while competition with neighbors rewires the jaws and snout on the inside (3.3× to 9.3× faster) so sister species can share the same coral reef without fighting over the same food.
